params.body:
A public page, `/connect`, that gets a reader's AI tool onto Gentells in a minute. The agent door (the MCP server at `/mcp` with OAuth, and the Claude Code plugin) has existed since 13 September. How to use it was only on the account page, as text, for signed-in readers.

YPulse's MCP page is a sales page that ends in "Book a demo", with no install path. This one installs.

## One card per tool
| tool | how |
|---|---|
| Claude Code | the plugin (`claude plugin marketplace add Trendwolves/gentells-plugin`, `claude plugin install gentells@gentells`), and `claude mcp add --transport http gentells …/mcp` without it |
| Claude (claude.ai, desktop) | the address, and Settings, then Connectors, then Add custom connector |
| ChatGPT | the address, as a connector in developer mode with OAuth |
| Codex | `codex mcp add gentells --url …/mcp`, then `codex mcp login gentells` |
| Cursor | an "Add to Cursor" button: `cursor://anysphere.cursor-deeplink/mcp/install?name=gentells&config=<base64 of {"url": …/mcp}>` |

- Every command and address has a copy button, on its own bar so it never covers the end of a line.
- The sign-in is always the reader's own Gentells account in the browser.

## Checked against each tool's documentation
- Claude Code: against the installed CLI's help.
- Codex: against OpenAI's MCP page.
- Cursor: against its install-link page.

VS Code is left out: its documentation did not confirm an install-link format, and a wrong link is worse than none.

## Links to it
- The pricing page: "Every plan also reads in your AI tool".
- The account page's "Your agent" section.

## Tests
- Each exact command and the server address appear on the page.
- The Cursor link decodes to `{"url": "<site>/mcp"}`.
- Pricing links to the page.

Checked in a browser at 1440px. 332 pass.
params.title: Connect: Gentells in Claude, ChatGPT, Codex and Cursor in a minute
